textRuns.value: Revenue = net of 'delivered' orders only (shipped, returned, cancelled, created and paid orders are excluded). Stockout = stockout_days >= 3 in a product-month. Overstock = days_of_supply > 180. Return Rate = return units / units sold over delivered + returned orders. SLA = lead time <= 7 days (no promised delivery date exists in the data). Currency: VND for prices, costs, discounts, revenue and refunds; USD for shipping_fee - the two are never added together. Inventory is a monthly product snapshot and is never summed across dates. 2012 (Jul-Dec) is a partial year.
